verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Firstbase's core incorporation service is real and used by founders (comm-1: Delaware/Wyoming incorporation completed in ~2 weeks) and docs reference incorporating a company (docs-23, docs-30) and post-incorporation cap-table setup (docs-29), but there is no explicit mention of generating bylaws or facilitating initial board approvals/resolutions as part of the flow. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of bylaws generation, initial board consent/approval workflow, and independent confirmation these specific artifacts are produced end-to-end.
